construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Strict JSON object with synthetic=true, residency EU or US, authenticated_account_id, subscriber_account, network_fault_tickets, cdr_csv, support_chat_transcripts, knowledge_base and question.
shared_schema.records: Every entity, nested adjustment, message, question and KB article requires matching residency and synthetic=true; CSV uses the literal true. Subscriber ownership must match.
shared_schema.output: JSON envelope: status answered|abstained|error, build_id, synthetic, residency, answer, source_ids, reason, context_counts. Errors have no answer or sources and exit 2; successful answers and abstentions exit 0.
shared_schema.validation: The validate function implements both input record validation and output envelope validation.

cross_stage_handoffs: One functionality only: shared validation -> deterministic lexical KB retrieval -> extractive grounded answer or explicit abstention -> shared output validation.
Optional injected answerer receives only a public candidate answer and source IDs; exact candidate equality is required.
behavior: Requires at least two distinct non-stopword query tokens matched against KB title and keywords, covering at least half of query tokens.
Tied top scores and absent sufficient matches explicitly abstain.
Answers reproduce one public KB answer verbatim and cite its article ID; tickets and CDRs do not establish outage facts.
Demonstrates GDPR/CCPA-oriented data minimization, support processing permission and caller/account matching, not compliance certification.
Never exposes subscriber fields or transcript text to the injected callable; responses provide only public KB text and aggregate record counts.
Requires a stated billing adjustment reason; never executes credits.
Rejects mixed residency on all record types, nonfinite or negative usage, duplicate IDs, duplicate JSON keys and unlabeled real data.
Fictitious reserved phone numbers, zero-prefix synthetic IMEIs and invented tickets are clearly labeled; seeded tests randomize synthetic usage volumes.

included: Call detail CSV parsing and support chat transcript validation
Grounded retrieval, abstention and injectable callable fixtures
CLI JSON success and error behavior
excluded: Live model providers, networks, databases or account changes
Real authentication: caller account ID is a trusted harness assertion
Legal compliance certification or comprehensive PII detection
Physical data residency enforcement, encryption, erasure and retention workflows
Production billing approval, outage diagnosis or arbitrary question reasoning

unit_tests.coverage: Normal, unknown/ambiguous queries, invalid schemas/CSV/JSON, residency at every record level, billing reasons, subscriber permission/ownership, synthetic labels, seeded randomized usage, transcript instruction isolation, private KB rejection, injected callable grounding/failure, output validation and CLI success/errors.
